title: Introduction of the Euro
summary: Addresses how IAS 21 should be applied when a country's national currency is replaced by a new common currency at a fixed conversion rate, confirming that no gain or loss arises from the fixing event itself.

related.title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
related.relationship: The parent standard SIC-7 confirms should continue to apply unchanged through a fixed-rate currency changeover

related.title: Financial Instruments
related.relationship: Governs hedge accounting relationships whose continuity through the transition period SIC-7 confirms is not disrupted

related.title: Hedges of a Net Investment in a Foreign Operation
related.relationship: Addresses net investment hedges broadly, complementary to SIC-7's specific confirmation about currency changeover events
